images.author: Dwight Burdette
images.caption: MC Sports store, Oak Valley Shopping Center, 2677 Oak Valley Drive, Ann Arbor, Michigan. This Store has relocated to the nearby Briarwood Mall Ann Arbor, Michigan

facade.notes: a 1990s shopping-centre bay: a big front gable clad in vinyl lap siding carries the store's name in channel letters, a shingled mansard-like roof runs along the row as a false roof over the flat-roofed box; split-face block piers frame full-height store glass; a covered walk; a planted tree and a trash can at the curb

why.note: 3-5 spaces per 1,000 sq ft puts a parking field 3-4x the building's area between it and the road
the 1980s-90s 'residential' strip: false gables and mansards to look like a village in suburbs that demanded it
